notes:
Opening a series or anime from Continue Watching now behaves like any other episode. Pressing OK on the resume episode collapses its stream list instead of leaving the page, and pressing OK again re-opens it. The episode you came back for is focused and scrolled into view, and focus stays on it as you open and close the list.

Search results, My List, Continue Watching and the browse grids all use the same poster size as the home rows — search posters were noticeably larger than everything else.

Fixed D-pad navigation in search results: left and right now stay within the row of results instead of jumping up into the Movies/Series/Anime filters and changing the category.
